name_de: UK: Instagram ignoriert laut Studie 90 Prozent gemeldeter Hass-Nachrichten an Frauen
name_en: Instagram fails to act on 90% of abusive DMs reported by women
description: Das Center for Countering Digital Hate (CCDH) analysierte 8.717 Direktnachrichten an fuenf prominente Frauen (u.a. Amber Heard, Rachel Riley) und stellte fest, dass Instagrams Moderation rund 90 Prozent der gemeldeten missbraeuchlichen Nachrichten nicht ahndete. 227 gemeldete Konten blieben mindestens einen Monat aktiv; bei keinem einzigen Fall bildbasierten sexuellen Missbrauchs reagierte die Plattform binnen 48 Stunden. Der Bericht erschien im April 2022.

description_en: The Center for Countering Digital Hate (CCDH) analysed 8,717 direct messages sent to five high-profile women (including Amber Heard and Rachel Riley) and found that Instagram's moderation failed to act on roughly 90 percent of reported abusive messages. 227 reported accounts remained active for at least a month, and the platform acted on none of the image-based sexual abuse cases within 48 hours. The report was published in April 2022.
